edition: Ma'ariful Qur'an by Mufti Muhammad Shafi (8 Volumes)

surahs.thematicSummary: The quintessence of the Holy Qur'an, embodying praise of Allah, affirmation of His sovereign Lordship and mercy, and the quintessential prayer for guidance along the Straight Path.

surahs.thematicSummary: The longest chapter covering the tripartite division of humanity, covenantal history with Bani Isra'il, the appointment of Adam, legal rulings on fasting, pilgrimage, marriage, and total prohibition of Riba.

Universal Call to Monotheism & Cosmic Signs of Creation
The Primordial Covenant & Appointment of Adam as Vicegerent
Injunctions on Fasting (Siyam) & The Sanctity of Ramadan
The Total Prohibition of Usury (Riba) & Economic Justice

surahs.thematicSummary: Affirmation of Tawhid against Trinitarian dogma, birth of Maryam and 'Isa, the Battle of Uhud, and steadfast devotion to the rope of Allah.

sectionsPreview.title: Definitive (Muhkam) and Allegorical (Mutashabih) Verses
Holding Fast to the Rope of Allah & Mutual Brotherhood

surahs.thematicSummary: Protection of orphans and widows, precise laws of estate inheritance (Mawarith), sanctity of marriage contracts, and social equity.

sectionsPreview.title: Sanctity of the Human Soul & Protection of Orphans' Wealth

surahs.thematicSummary: Fulfillment of covenants, dietary and ritual purification rulings, prohibition of intoxicants and gambling, and the disciples' table spread.

sectionsPreview.title: Fulfillment of Treaties & Halal Sanctity

surahs.thematicSummary: Systematic proof of Tawhid, refutation of pagan superstitions and idol worship, and the cosmic majesty of Allah's sovereignty.
The Primordial Covenant (Alast), arrogance of Iblis, and comprehensive prophetic narratives of Hud, Salih, Lut, Shu'ayb, and Musa.
The lessons of the decisive Battle of Badr, divine assistance through angels, spiritual discipline, and distribution of state spoils.
Severance of polytheistic treaties, campaign of Tabuk, exposure of hypocrites, and sincere repentance accepted by Allah.
Divine signs in heaven and earth, prophetic missions, and the redemption of the people of Prophet Yunus.
Steadfastness of messengers, historical demises of rebellious civilizations (Ad, Thamud, Sodom), and comfort for the Prophet.
The 'Best of Stories' detailing Prophet Yusuf's patience through betrayal, servitude, false imprisonment, and ultimate royal elevation in Egypt.
The thunder celebrating Allah's praises, cosmic governance, and peace of heart found exclusively in the remembrance of Allah.
The parables of the good word and evil word, Prophet Ibrahim's heartfelt prayers for his progeny and the sanctuary of Makkah.
Divine guarantee of Qur'anic preservation, creation of Adam from dried clay, and the warning to the rocky city of Thamud.
Enumeration of boundless divine blessings, the miracle of the honeybee, and the golden rule of justice, excellence, and kin care.
The miraculous Night Journey to Jerusalem, moral commandments of filial piety, humility, and the spiritual healing within the Quran.
Protection against the trials of Dajjal through four parables: the Youth of the Cave (Faith), Two Gardens (Wealth), Musa & Khidr (Knowledge), and Dhul-Qarnayn (Power).

sectionsPreview.title: Praise of Allah for the Incorruptible Scripture & Warnings
The Companions of the Cave (Ashab al-Kahf) & Divine Sanctuary

surahs.thematicSummary: The miraculous births of Yahya and 'Isa, the chastity of Maryam, and the monotheistic heritage of early prophetic dynasties.
Consolation of the Prophet, Musa's vision of the burning bush at Mount Tuwa, confrontation with Pharaoh, and the golden calf.
The closeness of humanity's reckoning, cosmic unity of creation, Ibrahim's trial by fire, and the sending of the Prophet as mercy to all worlds.
The earthquake of the Hour, the rites and spiritual objectives of Hajj, sacrificial animals, and permission for defensive struggle.
The defining characteristics of successful believers in Salah and chastity, human embryology, and the eternal abode of Firdaus.
Social decorum, domestic privacy, the Verse of Light (Ayat an-Nur), vindication of Sayyidah 'A'ishah, and modest dress codes.
The Quran as the criterion between truth and falsehood, celestial signs, and the noble virtues of the Servants of the Most Merciful ('Ibad ar-Rahman).
Rhythmic accounts of prophets meeting obstinate deniers, the true nature of Quranic revelation, and contrast with frivolous poets.
Sulayman's kingdom, the speech of birds and ants, the Queen of Sheba (Bilqis), and signs of divine wisdom in the cosmos.
Musa's infancy cast upon the Nile, upbringing in Pharaoh's palace, escape to Madyan, and the ruin of proud Qarun.
Testing of faith in worldly life, the fragility of polytheistic reliance likened to the spider's web, and striving in Allah's path.
Prophecy of Byzantine resurgence over Sassanids, cosmic signs in marital love and diverse languages, and the innate human fitrah.
The pedagogical wisdom of sage Luqman advising his son regarding shirk, gratitude, establishing prayer, and walking with humility.
Creation of humanity from clay and spirit, the nightly devotion of believers whose sides forsake their beds, and the Day of Judgment.
The Siege of Madinah (Trench), the Prophet as the supreme exemplar (Uswah Hasanah), Seal of the Prophets, and the trust (Amanah).
Gratitude exemplified by Dawud and Sulayman versus ungrateful ruin of the people of Sheba by the Great Dam flood (Sayl al-'Arim).
Allah as Originator of heavens and earth creating winged angels, human vulnerability before the Self-Sufficient Lord, and inherited scripture.
The 'Heart of the Qur'an' addressing prophetic truth, the Town's envoys and Habib the carpenter, cosmic celestial mechanics, and resurrection of dry bones.

sectionsPreview.title: The Oath by the Wise Quran & The Mission of the Messenger
Signs of Resurrecting Barren Earth, Night and Orbiting Spheres

surahs.thematicSummary: Angelic hosts aligned in celestial ranks, Ibrahim's ultimate willingness to sacrifice his son, and salutations upon the messengers.
Admonition through scripture, Dawud's repentance in judicial arbitration, Ayyub's endurance through illness, and Iblis's expulsion.
Sincere monotheism, the famous verse of boundless hope for transgressing souls (39:53), and entry of righteous crowds into Paradise.
First of the Hawamim surahs; Allah's forgiveness and severe reckoning, the secret Believer in Pharaoh's court pleading for Musa.
The protector from the punishment of the grave; creation of life and death as a test of deeds, flawless celestial architecture, and sustenance.

sectionsPreview.title: Blessed Sovereignty, Flawless Creation & Seven Heavens

surahs.thematicSummary: Equal to one-third of the Quran; absolute definition of pure Tawhid: Allah is One, the Eternal Refuge, Unbegotten and Unbegetting.

sectionsPreview.title: Absolute Oneness, As-Samad & Incomparability

surahs.thematicSummary: Seeking refuge with the Lord of daybreak from external perils: the darkness of night, secret witchcraft blowers, and malignant envy.

sectionsPreview.title: Refuge from Creation Perils, Darkness, Sorcery & Envy

surahs.thematicSummary: Seeking refuge with the Sovereign King and God of humanity from the stealthy internal whisperer (Al-Waswas Al-Khannas).

sectionsPreview.title: Refuge in the Sovereign Lord from Insidious Whisperers
